page_title: BAY 4-0 UNI | Bayern Munich v Union Berlin 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
87' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Erblin Osmani (Bayern Munich) replaces Leon Goretzka.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Maycon Cardozo (Bayern Munich) is replacing Serge Gnabry.
85' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
83' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
82' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
81' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
80' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Patrick Ittrich signals a set piece.

78' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
76' That will be all from Christopher Trimmel who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
75' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
73' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
71' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Min-Jae Kim.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.

67' 4 - 0 After a goalmouth scramble Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) wins the ball and unleashes a powerful and precise effort into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper. A wonderful football moment.

65' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
65' The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
63' The ball possession at the moment is 73:27.
61' It will be a substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is ready to enter the pitch as Dayot Upamecano walks off.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lennart Karl leaves the pitch and Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) comes on.
61' Here is a change. Aljoscha Kemlein is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch so that Livan Burcu can be given a rest.
60' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

59' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.

57' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Frederik Ronnow, who pulls off a decent save!
56' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
53' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) latches on to a fine cross and powers an effort in on goal, but the goalkeeper is ready and makes a good save.
52' 15:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

49' 3 - 0 Goal! Konrad Laimer plays in Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 3:0.

48' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
46' Steffen Baumgart makes a half-time substitution. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) comes on in place of Stanley Nsoki.
46' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Tim Skarke is replaced by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!

42' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
40' A rebound spins to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
37' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

37' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a throw-in.
35' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
33' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a poor free kick into the box that Frederik Ronnow easily collects.

33' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Bayern Munich.
30' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

29' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
27' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a short pass into the box, Leon Goretzka takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
26' It looks like Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Patrick Ittrich won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
23' The corner kick from Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
23' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
22' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin have a free kick.

21' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
19' Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to intercept the corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
18' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

16' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
16' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

15' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' The resulting corner, taken by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.

10' Bayern Munich will take a corner kick. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

9' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Harry Kane, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
5' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) picks up a long through ball, but Frederik Ronnow deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
3' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
2' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
